contract_assessment.trust_model: Prepared index is an internal validated immutable view, not a cryptographic or mutable-file cache. Exact backing start+length is checked after unchanged bounds/policy guards. Equal-content copies, shifted/shortened views, empty contexts and new artifact buffers refuse. Equal start+length with restricted capacity is the same content view and correctly accepts.
contract_assessment.actual_callers: Serena/source references establish production callers: existing specification passes the index already made from its pinned source; manifest retains only each successfully parsed member index with that member buffer; source-color default recursion reuses current index once and terminates. Default/render calls and fresh artifact verification retain nil/fresh parsing. Neither source nor parsed metadata is mutated by those callers.
contract_assessment.lifetime_and_mutability: The unexported source slice keeps backing bytes alive during use. Manifest allocates a new member byte slice and resets context per entry; no shared pool/global cache crosses members. Edited artifact storage is separately cloned; parsed source/index remain unchanged. In-place content/index mutation or forged same-package contexts are outside this explicit contract and are not detected; any future buffer pooling/mutable caller must reparse or establish a new ownership contract.
contract_assessment.refusal_order: Unchanged dimension/selector/policy guards run first. Prepared context validation then precedes selected traversal; per-entry metadata and cumulative chunk checks retain original order before duplicate-count failure. No fallback reparsing for foreign context.
contract_assessment.reuse_and_readability: Small enhancement to the existing parser/codec and live callers, without new function/helper/parser/cache global. An extra explicit internal argument is justified by the existing ownership boundary; required preparse for all callers or per-native hashes would spread responsibilities or preserve repeated work.
